1. [TEMPORAL] The DV-2024 entry period will run from 12:00 pm (noon), Eastern Daylight Time (EDT) on Wednesday, October 5, 2022, until 12:00 pm (noon), Eastern Standard Time (EST) on Tuesday, November 8, 2022.
2. [FACT] Each year, millions of people submit entries for the DV program.
3. [ASSISTANT_SAID] Restricting the entry period to these dates ensures selectees receive notification in a timely manner and gives both the visa applicants and embassies and consulates time to prepare and complete cases for visa issuance.
4. [ASSISTANT_SAID] We strongly encourage you to enter early during the registration period.
5. [ASSISTANT_SAID] Excessive demand at the end of the registration period may slow the processing system.
6. [ASSISTANT_SAID] We cannot accept entries after noon EST on Tuesday, November 8, 2022.
7. [FACT] An entrant may apply while in the United States or another country.
8. [ASSISTANT_SAID] An entrant may submit an entry from any location.
9. [FACT] The law allows only one entry per person during each registration period.
10. [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Department of State uses sophisticated technology to detect multiple entries.
11. [ASSISTANT_SAID] Individuals with more than one entry will be ineligible for a DV.
12. [FACT] Each spouse may submit one entry if each meets the eligibility requirements.
13. [ASSISTANT_SAID] If either spouse is selected, the other is entitled to apply as a derivative dependent.
14. [FACT] If you are legally married, you must list your spouse regardless of whether he/she lives with you or intends to immigrate to the United States.
15. [ASSISTANT_SAID] You must list your spouse even if you currently are separated from him/her unless you are legally separated.
16. [ASSISTANT_SAID] Legal separation is an arrangement when a couple remains married but lives apart, following a court order.
17. [ASSISTANT_SAID] If you and your spouse are legally separated, your spouse will not be able to immigrate with you through the Diversity Visa program.
18. [ASSISTANT_SAID] You will not be penalized if you choose to enter the name of a spouse from whom you are legally separated.
19. [ASSISTANT_SAID] If you are not legally separated by a court order, you must include your spouse even if you plan to be divorced before you apply for
